content:
Time in Class 3 covers reading the clock to the minute, a.m./p.m., the 24-hour clock and the calendar. This guide explains what the IMO Class 3 time chapter tests, the facts to know, the traps, and a free 10-question test.

What the Class 3 Maths Olympiad Time chapter tests

  • Reading the clock to the minute
  • a.m./p.m. and the 24-hour clock
  • The calendar (days, weeks, months, leap year)
  • Elapsed time and conversions

Key facts your child should know

  • The short hand shows the hour; each clock number is 5 minutes for the long hand.
  • a.m. is midnight–noon; p.m. is noon–midnight; 1 p.m. = 13:00.
  • 1 hour = 60 minutes; 1 day = 24 hours; 1 week = 7 days.
  • 1 year = 12 months = 365 days (366 in a leap year).

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Reading the long hand as the hour.
  • Getting a.m./p.m. wrong across noon or midnight.
  • Miscounting elapsed time across the hour.

quiz.title: IMO Class 3 Time Quiz
quiz.intro: Ten Olympiad-pattern questions. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.

questions.q: How many seconds are there in 5 minutes?
The time "10 minutes to 6" is the same as ___.
questions.explanation: 10 minutes to 6 means 10 minutes before 6 o'clock: 5:50.

questions.q: How much time passes from 9:00 am to 11:30 am?
questions.explanation: From 9:00 am to 11:30 am is 150 minutes = 2 h 30 min.

questions.q: The time "15 minutes to 4" is the same as ___.
questions.explanation: 15 minutes to 4 means 15 minutes before 4 o'clock: 3:45.
8:15 means 15 minutes after 8 o'clock, which is called "quarter past 8".

questions.q: How many minutes are there in 6 hours?
The time "20 minutes to 9" is the same as ___.
questions.explanation: 20 minutes to 9 means 20 minutes before 9 o'clock: 8:40.

questions.q: A cricket match starts at 10:30 am and runs for 3 h 15 min. At what time does it end?
If today is Thursday, what day will it be after 2 days?
questions.explanation: Counting 2 days on from Thursday lands on Saturday.

questions.q: Which of these months has exactly 30 days: September, January, February?
questions.explanation: September has 30 days, while January has 31 and February has 28 (or 29 in a leap year).

faq.q: How do you write p.m. time in the 24-hour clock?
faq.a: Add 12 to the hour: 3 p.m. = 15:00, 8 p.m. = 20:00.

faq.q: How many minutes are in an hour?
faq.a: Sixty. Half past is 30 minutes and quarter past is 15 minutes.
